overview.description: The Corgi U.S. Technology 2x Daily ETF (XLKX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of the Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF (Ticker: XLK), which provides exposure to US technology stocks. XLKX was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
